concepts.name: Seasonal monsoon circulation
concepts.mechanism: The South Asian monsoon reorganizes atmospheric circulation seasonally. Land-ocean heating contrasts, shifting convergence, pressure gradients, cross-equatorial flow and moisture transport interact with upper-level winds and relief. It is more than a giant sea breeze or a synonym for heavy rain.
concepts.example: A wet spell requires moisture transport and favourable ascent. Regional topography can make rainfall differ within the same seasonal circulation.
concepts.mistake: One heating contrast does not completely explain the timing, intensity and spatial pattern of the monsoon.

concepts.name: Monsoon variability and evidence
concepts.mechanism: Monsoon rainfall varies within a season and between years. Moisture paths, weather systems, active/break periods and ocean-atmosphere variability interact. A climate mode can change probabilities without determining each year's or district's outcome. Evaluate dates, geography and uncertainty before using a forecast or statistic.
concepts.example: A seasonal national rainfall summary can conceal regional deficits and short intense events. Event and seasonal evidence answer different questions.
concepts.mistake: An El Niño label does not deterministically fix rainfall at every location, and an annual average does not describe each storm.
